title: Daily digest: Senate Republicans in US reject measure  | Shipping minister urges maritime regulat | Hyderabad: Man flags alleged insect infe | Telangana High Court asks Teenmar Mallan | Azam Khan's 'Biryani' Jibe At Asaduddin
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Al Jazeera / Times of India / Telangana Today / NDTV
bullets_en: Senate Republicans in US reject measure to limit Trump’s war powers in Iran.
Shipping minister has sought maritime regulator to be on high alert amid Gulf ship attacks.
Hyderabad: Man flags alleged insect infestation in chocolate.
Telangana High Court asks Teenmar Mallanna to approach SC on special courts’ jurisdiction.
Azam Khan's 'Biryani' Jibe At Asaduddin Owaisi Amid Tussle For UP Muslim Votes.
bullets_ur: US Senate ke Republicans ne Iran mein Trump ke jangi ikhtiyarat mehdood karne ki tajweez radd kar di.
Gulf mein jahazon par hamlon ke baais Shipping minister ne maritime regulator ko high alert rehne ki hidayat ki.
Hyderabad: Ek shakhs ne chocolate mein keere hone ki shikayat kar di.
Telangana High Court ne Teenmar Mallanna ko khususi adalaton ke ikhtiyarat par SC se rujo karne ki hidayat ki.
UP ke Muslim votes ki jang ke dauran Azam Khan ka Asaduddin Owaisi par 'Biryani' ka tanz.
